items.title: Prompt Injection
items.summary: Crafted input alters the model's behaviour or output in unintended ways, directly or through content the model reads.

items.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
items.summary: The model reveals personal data, credentials or confidential business data in its output.

items.title: Supply Chain
items.summary: Compromised models, datasets, adapters or plugins introduce vulnerabilities.

items.title: Data and Model Poisoning
items.summary: Training, fine-tuning or embedding data is manipulated to introduce backdoors or bias.

items.title: Improper Output Handling
items.summary: Model output is passed to downstream systems without validation, enabling XSS, SQL injection or code execution.

items.title: Excessive Agency
items.summary: The model is given more functionality, permissions or autonomy than it needs.

items.title: System Prompt Leakage
items.summary: System prompts containing sensitive logic or secrets are exposed.

items.title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
items.summary: Weaknesses in how embeddings are generated, stored or retrieved are exploited, including cross-tenant leakage in RAG.

items.title: Misinformation
items.summary: The model produces false or misleading information that users or systems rely on.

items.title: Unbounded Consumption
items.summary: Uncontrolled inference requests cause denial of service, cost blow-ups or model extraction.
